title: Al Mashreq For Chemicals
category: Brand Identity • Brand Guidelines • Print Design
description: Al Mashreq For Chemicals is an agricultural solutions company specializing in high-quality fertilizers designed to support plant growth and improve agricultural productivity. The project focused on building a complete visual identity that could communicate innovation, reliability, and a strong connection to modern agriculture while providing the brand with a consistent foundation for future growth.
challenge: Al Mashreq needed more than a distinctive logo; it required a complete visual language that could work consistently across different communication channels. The identity had to balance the technical nature of the agricultural chemicals industry with a more modern and approachable visual character. Another key challenge was creating a bilingual identity that could maintain the same personality and visual balance across both Arabic and English applications.
solution: A complete brand identity system was developed around a custom logo concept combining the brand name with a sun-inspired symbol. The visual language was built around a distinctive orange and blue color palette, supported by carefully selected typography for both Arabic and English communication. Custom patterns and textures were created from the brand symbol to extend the identity beyond the logo and create additional visual assets. The system was documented through detailed logo construction, color specifications, typography, usage guidelines, and bilingual logo applications, then extended into practical brand stationery including business cards, letterheads, folders, envelopes, and branded apparel.
results: The project established a structured and scalable visual identity for Al Mashreq For Chemicals. The combination of a bilingual logo system, defined color palette, typography, supporting patterns, and usage guidelines created a consistent framework for future brand communication. The identity was also translated into practical stationery applications, allowing the visual language to move from the brand guidelines into everyday business materials while maintaining a unified presence.
